title.en: Fable 15 — The Ass and His Masters

sentences.en: A donkey worked for a gardener.
Hard work.
Carrying water, earth, vegetables.
From morning to evening.
And little food.
And the donkey grew sick of it.

sentences.ar: وقال: يا رب، أعطيني صاحب تاني.
sentences.en: And said: Lord, give me another master.
And the gardener sold him to a potter.
And the potter loaded him with clay.
Heavy, wet clay.
And big jars.
Heavier than the water and vegetables.
And the donkey said: this is worse.
Lord, give me another master.
And the potter sold him to a tanner.
The tanner works with hides.
The hides of dead animals.
And the donkey saw the hides.
And smelled the smell.
And understood.
The donkey said: woe is me.
With the gardener, I worked.
With the potter, I toiled.
And here, when I die, he tans my hide.
If only I had stayed with the first.
Whoever changes too often loses the more.
